title: Plan P2-005 infrastructure trust-zone contracts
businessObjective: Make future Staff and AI infrastructure portable and isolated from guest operations without selecting or provisioning any provider.
technicalObjective: Write an exact finite design for P2-005 static trust-zone and provider-neutral port contracts, make its product packet executable-ready, and define a separate narrow exact validator-admission task; do not implement a contract or infrastructure.
assumptions: P2-005 is static Tier-0 contract work only.
No cloud account, domain, service, credential, SDK, queue, database, deployment, network call, or production integration is selected, accessed, or configured.
A separate governance task must admit P2-005's exact validator before product implementation and independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: The design defines one closed Draft 2020-12 V1 contract authority, exact finite zone/port/request/rejection fields and bounds, and a minimal runtime-safe semantic public surface that obtains committed authority internally and accepts no caller-supplied policy, schema, adapter, or configuration.

The design fixes distinct guest/public, staff/control, and AI/workload zones; separate credential, quota, deployment, and failure boundaries; booking isolation; authenticated audience-bound short-lived HTTPS; recipient-side expiry/audience/timestamp/nonce/replay/idempotency handling; bounded request/response/timeouts; and caller/route limits.

The design defines finite provider-neutral ports for persistence, event ingestion, analytics, scheduling/queues, workflow, object storage, notifications, intelligence, deployment, authentication, proposal generation, executor adapters, and verification providers; core has no provider or infrastructure imports.

The design defines deterministic fail-closed reason codes and focused real exploit regressions for malformed input, unauthenticated/mis-audienced/expired/replayed calls, duplicate idempotency, unbounded body/timeout, rate-limit bypass, zone confusion, provider authority, shared booking/AI capacity, unsupported ports, caller authority injection, and never-throw behavior.

The P2-005 packet is updated with exact allowed paths, task-specific machine-evidence path, real exact validator command, required checks, rollback, GOV-047/GOV-048 dependencies, no production permissions, and a separate GOV-048 packet admits only the exact literal shell-free validator command with focused rejection coverage.

The planning output preserves deep-module, hexagonal-port, minimisation, retention, quota, and approval boundaries; it introduces no schema/module/test implementation, service, adapter, SDK, external call, provider selection, or production behavior.
requiredChecks: finite trust-zone and protocol design review
packet and exact verifier-admission readiness review
solEscalationTriggers: Any provider/account/domain selection, credential/authentication weakening, network/infrastructure provisioning, public exposure, database/queue/storage action, booking-boundary change, runtime adapter implementation, or product contract implementation requires a separate approved packet.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the GOV-047 design, P2-005/GOV-048 future-packet preparation, task state, permanent-memory/risk entries, and GOV-047 evidence; preserve terminal P2-002/P2-004/GOV-043 history, canonical sources, immutable snapshot, and all external systems.
